messages.text:
I’ll build a Python xsv-compatible CLI focused on the requested commands, using the Rust source and official binary behavior as the oracle.

I’ll first inspect the reference command structure and existing root files once, then implement the port and compile wrapper.

commands.commandLine:
Get-Content -Raw REFERENCE_BINARY.txt
Get-Content -Raw PYTHON_PORT_TASK.md
Get-Content -Raw compile.sh
rg -n "static USAGE|struct Args|fn run|pub fn run|Config::new|Delimiter|no_headers|select\(|Selection|reverse|numeric|ignore_case|stats|frequency|headers|count|slice|search|sort|table|fmt" rust-reference/src rust-reference/tests
